headline.text: L1 S4 kitchen down 6 hours after metal spatula *broke inside mixing tank* — metal and plastic pieces recovered from filter, full system clean completed.

summary: One hold at L1 S1 (underweight pouches, rework in progress). Two metal contamination events at L1: broken spatula in S4 kitchen and screw fragment in S1 decorator pump. Sanitation re-cleans underway at L1 (Hapman lids) and L3 ML4 (flow wrap parts).

holds.title: 4 pallets held for low piece count
holds.summary: First four pallets of S1 pretzel pouches placed on hold due to piece count below spec (65 pieces vs 85+ required) caused by overweight individual pieces.
holds.status: Rework authorized — pallets to be opened and rerun back onto line per Curt Willis at 15:15 MT.

food_safety.title: Metal spatula broke in S4 mixing tank
food_safety.summary: Metal scraper blade and plastic handle fragments found in S4 kitchen mixing tank and filter during batch preparation — metal part recovered intact after full drain, plastic residue cleared from filter.
food_safety.status: Resolved — kettle, mixing tank, filter, and all piping washed and sanitized; first post-clean batch in spec at 11:15 MT.

food_safety.title: Screw piece found in S1 decorator pump
food_safety.summary: Piece of screw discovered in decorator riser pump motor housing during fault troubleshooting — origin unknown, maintenance cleaned pump chamber and line resumed.
food_safety.status: Open — screw fragment recovered, pump cleaned, line running; source of screw not yet identified.

quality.title: S2 jar label roll misprinted
quality.summary: One roll of S2 jar labels with text cut off at trailing edge — QA pulled roll and placed on hold.
quality.status: Resolved — defective roll removed from line and held; Ethan Bean notified for supplier follow-up.

quality.title: S1 pretzel piece weight 35% over spec
quality.summary: Individual piece weight running 8.2g vs 5.9g target, causing pouch piece count to drop to 65 (spec 85-95) despite meeting minimum pouch weight — blower and shaker both at 100%.
quality.status: Open at window close — team dialing in chocolate coverage; spec allows 85 pieces minimum as long as pouch weight holds.

quality.title: ML2 bars breaking at demold
quality.summary: Approximately 4 broken bars per mold coming through demolding — worker stationed at belt to hand-sort and prevent packaging.
quality.status: Open — demolding hammers adjusted from 2.2 to 1.9 bar and mold temp raised from 47°C to 49°C at 14:45 MT; monitoring for improvement.

quality.title: MF Matrix recipe weights modified without authorization
quality.summary: 16oz recipe weights and tare (34g) found changed in scale with no record of who or why — actual output still within spec minimum.
quality.status: Resolved — weights corrected back to spec in scale at 07:45 MT; no rework required as all pouches met spec minimum.

sanitation.title: Hapman lids & cones failed APC verification
sanitation.summary: Elevated APC results on S3 Hapman lids and cones after cleaning — equipment requires 3 re-cleans with APC swab after each cycle.
sanitation.status: Open — first of three required re-cleans in progress; inline filter for S3 also pending lab results due to lab issue.

sanitation.title: ML4 flow wrap parts box 39 failed environmental swab
sanitation.summary: Environmental testing on TG flow wrap parts showed out-of-spec results on box 39 only — parts re-cleaned same day during line-down window.
sanitation.status: Resolved — box 39 parts re-cleaned and first environmental re-test taken at 12:48 MT; results pending.

opportunities.text: Consider adding pre-shift kitchen tool inspection to S4 startup checklist — today's broken metal spatula in mixing tank required 6-hour line-down and full system sanitization.
Review metal-detector and X-ray test card protocols on S1 — screw fragment found in decorator pump suggests possible equipment degradation post-maintenance or installation.

Add post-cleaning assembly verification step to ML4 Theegarten procedure — today's TG4 reassembly errors included belt installed above rails (causing rip), plastic and metal parts swapped in metal detector, and rollers in wrong positions.
Enforce recipe change authorization on MF Matrix — today's unauthorized weight and tare modifications went untracked until QA audit; consider lockout or two-person rule for recipe edits.
